annotations.title: Translate a game's texts (owner's own AI)

description:
Translations of a game's texts into the klyo languages (pl, en, de, fr, es, pt, it, ru, uk, tr). YOU TRANSLATE: the owner's assistant, on the owner's own AI plan; klyo runs no model and does not pay for translation. Two steps in one tool: (1) call with only `slug` to get the original field by field (`oryginal`), the original language, the languages still to do (`do_tlumaczenia`, with their state) and the check rules; (2) call with `slug` and `tlumaczenia` = { language code: { field: text } } with ALL the fields from `oryginal`. Each language goes through the same check as the developer's own text: long dashes and the ellipsis character are replaced with plain ones, no markup, no longer than twice the original, the description at least 25 words with letters (`opis_slow_min`; a shorter one comes back with its word count), name and tagline on one line up to 80 characters, the text must be in that language, no disallowed words. A language that fails comes back in `odrzucone` with the reason: fix it and send it again; good languages are saved. What is saved are PROPOSALS: the owner approves them in the studio (dev.klyo.pl, the game, Translations) and only approved ones count for Google. Do not tell the user the translations are already on the page. This tool does not change the developer's own texts (English required, Polish for XP); that is klyo_fix_game. PAGE ADDRESS PER LANGUAGE: every language page of the game has its own address in that language (/de/spider-solitaer/, /uk/pasians-pavuk/), never the Polish one. Send `adres` with the language, or we derive it from the translated name; it is approved together with the texts and then stays stable (a later name change does not move it). ORDER: translate BEFORE the release, while the game waits (klyo_publish_game status `oczekuje`) and ask the owner to approve them; then the very first catalogue build has every language ready and indexable. Translations sent after the release leave those language pages for a few minutes as an unchecked machine translation, kept out of Google until approved.

Examples:
• Translate my game into all klyo languages
• What is missing in the translations of lantern-thief?
• Add German and French versions of my game's description

slug.description: Game address, for example lantern-thief (from klyo_my_games).

tlumaczenia.description: Omit to see what to translate. When saving: language code (pl, en, de, fr, es, pt, it, ru, uk, tr) → an object with ALL the fields from `oryginal` (nazwa, haslo, opis, sterowanie_dotyk, sterowanie_klawiatura, czas_partii; only those the game has). Optional `adres` (every language, pl and en too): the game page address in that language, the words players of that language type into Google, lowercase Latin letters, digits and single hyphens, 2 to 60 characters (German "Spider Solitär" → spider-solitaer, Ukrainian "Пасьянс Павук" → pasians-pavuk, Polish players search "durak", so the Polish page is durak, not duren from the accented Polish name). Without it we build it from the translated `nazwa` (pl and en keep their address). The address of the original language and of languages with the developer's own text is set with klyo_fix_game `adres`. A taken or reserved address comes back in `odrzucone`; after the owner approves, the old address redirects 301 to the new one.
